description: Known-answer vectors for the crypto_version = 1 primitives of Nodra spec §23.1. Every value is copied from a published source; none was produced by this implementation.

sources.hkdf: RFC 5869 Appendix A, SHA-256 test cases 1-3. Hex transcribed from the RFC; the byte ramps (00..4f, 60..af, b0..ff) were regenerated, the PRK/OKM values were not.
sources.aesGcm: Project Wycheproof (C2SP/wycheproof, testvectors_v1/aes_gcm_test.json): every test with keySize 256, ivSize 96 and tagSize 128.
sources.rsaOaep: Project Wycheproof, testvectors_v1/rsa_oaep_3072_sha256_mgf1sha256_test.json: the group key plus 4 valid unlabelled, 4 valid labelled and 8 invalid cases.
sources.ecdsaP1363: Project Wycheproof, testvectors_v1/ecdsa_secp256r1_sha256_p1363_test.json: the first group in full.
sources.hmacSha256: Project Wycheproof, testvectors_v1/hmac_sha256_test.json: 24 valid cases with keySize 256 and tagSize 256.

notation: All byte strings are lowercase hex. `result` is 'valid' (must verify/decrypt) or 'invalid' (must be rejected).

hkdf.name: RFC 5869 A.2 longer inputs and outputs
RFC 5869 A.3 zero-length salt and info
